about: The handle set each side of the cutover serves on tinyassets.io/mcp, and the authorization server its protected-resource document names, by which scripts/cutover_handles_canary.py tells the sides apart. Fact 11's handles canary holds whichever side it is asked for.

old.why: The old stack's live surface (PR-178 and the 2026-07-24 canonical convergence), as recorded: scripts/mcp_public_canary.py --assert-handles holds tools/list to exactly these. It leaves with the old stack.

new.why: The doors' tools for a custom connector: platform/doors/profiles.json's custom profile, what every MCP grant and API key is served until the owner narrows it, which is the doors' whole tool table (platform/doors/src/tools.ts). platform/doors/guards/handles.test.ts holds this list to both.
